h1.en: One concrete pump rubber spring φ180 row, sequenced like Arch bridge

directAnswer.en: Arch bridge is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump rubber spring φ180 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. The φ180 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
directAnswer.zh: 《Arch bridge》是百科页。concrete pump rubber spring φ180仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ180 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “History”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. The page lists φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. Rubber rows are φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230 and φ260. Polyurethane rows are φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. This φ180 row is rubber. Unit: piece. Hardness and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A split or integral piston at φ180, where that size exists, is a different product page and a different unit. φ235 is on the spring page only. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“历史”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 页面列出 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。橡胶行是 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ260。聚氨酯行是 φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。φ180 这一行是橡胶。单位：个。硬度和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 若分体或整体活塞也有 φ180，那是另一张产品页，单位也不同。φ235 只在弹簧页上。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Simple compression arch bridges

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Simple compression arch bridges”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write rubber spring or polyurethane spring, φ180, and the quantity in pieces, matching the material row above. The φ180 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Simple compression arch bridges”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 按上面的材料行写橡胶弹簧或聚氨酯弹簧、φ180 和个数。 φ180 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Types of arch bridge

body.en: Use “Types of arch bridge” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Types of arch bridge”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Use of modern materials”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“使用的 现代材料”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Records sizes”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 橡胶弹簧 page plus this size and the quantity. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arch_bridge
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Records sizes”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明橡胶弹簧这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arch_bridge
